steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable the RFX project feature required by the case.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB line item with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet fields required before publishing.
Set the line item's required delivery location.
Verify the requested delivery location was retained.
Commit the 30-minute schedule while leaving all other publish prerequisites complete.
Attempt publish without inviting a vendor and assert the exact participant-required refusal.
